messages.subject: Dubai Executive Profile | Energy, Infrastructure, ESG & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Marium,

Your Dubai-based executive-search work across industrial technology and senior leadership makes this a relevant introduction, particularly as Gulf markets continue scaling complex infrastructure and industrial transformation. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates in Saudi Arabia and the UAE where institutional relationships, regulation and responsible growth are strategic priorities. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
